summary: Frontend-only verification of role-based landing + Dashboard progressive render + date filter for HomeIVF CRM. Caller (agent@homeivf.com) correctly lands on /leads on login and root redirect, and can still open Dashboard from the left nav (data-testid='nav-dashboard' visible; /dashboard renders 'dashboard-page' with caller-scoped KPIs). Manager (kishore@homeivf.com) lands on /dashboard and root '/' also redirects to /dashboard, dashboard renders correctly. Admin (admin@homeivf.com) lands on /dashboard, all 6 KPI cards render with numeric values (1 / 12 / 0 / 0 / 1 / 1,19,813), funnel-by-stage, 14-day bar chart (recharts SVG), leaderboard-table and top-tags panels all render. Dashboard date-range filter (dashboard-date-from / dashboard-date-to) accepts values and the 'In range' summary text appears after change. No blank pages, no redirect loops, no console errors of concern.

ui_bugs.issue: Clear button with data-testid='dashboard-date-clear' was NOT found in the DOM on the admin dashboard. The from/to inputs work and the 'In range' summary updates, but the Clear button that the spec expects is missing (or its data-testid is different). Users currently have no explicit reset control.

action_items: Add the missing Dashboard 'Clear' button with data-testid='dashboard-date-clear' in pages/Dashboard.jsx (spec called it out but it is not rendered). Verify it resets both date-from and date-to and re-fetches the default (MTD) range.

Optional: KPI/panel skeletons (kpi-skeleton, panel-skeleton) were not visually captured because responses are fast/cached (<300ms). Progressive-render code path could be verified with a network throttle in a future run — not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Role-based landing implementation (RoleLanding + Guard perm='dashboard') is working correctly across caller/manager/admin — no redirect loops observed.
Dashboard nav item (data-testid='nav-dashboard') is visible for the caller as required, satisfying the 'Dashboard still one click away for everyone' requirement.
Caller-scoped dashboard renders with scoped KPIs (Total Active Leads = 5,270 for caller vs 1,19,813 for admin) — scope filter is being applied per role as expected.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (12/13 checks passed; only missing dashboard-date-clear testid)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Role-based landing + Dashboard progressive/parallel loading feature is verified working for all 3 roles. The only outstanding minor item is the missing dashboard-date-clear button testid. Backend section-split (kpis|panels) was already curl-verified by main agent in iteration_61 backend work; not retested here.
